summary_en: Full-year dividend raised to 25 yen/share from 22 yen/share for fiscal year ending 30 June 2026. Payout floor set at 2.5% DOE. Increase reflects upgrade to net income guidance (84.32 yen/share, +33.3% YoY) and management focus on shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Earnings and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Envipro Holdings revised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending 30 June 2026 on 30 July 2026. The full-year per-share dividend is raised to 25 yen from the prior forecast of 22 yen (a 3-yen increase). The company also upgraded its net earnings guidance to 84.32 yen/share, up 33.3% from the previous forecast of 63.24 yen/share, driven by stronger market conditions for scrap and non-ferrous metals, improved margin contributions from ongoing structural reforms, and better-than-expected demand. The dividend policy maintains a floor of 2.5% DOE (dividend on equity), reflecting a commitment to stable and continuous shareholder returns while funding sustainable growth. The revised dividend is subject to approval at the ordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for September 2026.
